title: Egyptian TV presenter among 12 sentenced to death for drug crime
text: Sarah Khalifa also owns a cosmetic surgery clinic and an event production company. View image in fullscreen Sarah Khalifa also owns a cosmetic surgery clinic and an event production company. Egypt Egyptian TV presenter among 12 sentenced to death for drug crime Sarah Khalifa, 39, charged with forming organised criminal gang to manufacture and traffick drugs AFP in Cairo Sat 5 Sep 2026 14.00 EDT Last modified on Sat 5 Sep 2026 14.08 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google An Egyptian court sentenced a well-known television presenter and 11 others to death for manufacturing and trafficking narcotics in a sprawling drug case, official media reported on Saturday. The presenter, Sarah Khalifa, 39, is best known for her programme Mission Impossible, which dealt with issues concerning security and crime. The state-linked Al-Ahram newspaper said a Cairo court sentenced “Khalifa and 11 other defendants to death by hanging on charges of forming an organised criminal gang specialising in procuring materials used in manufacturing narcotics, with the intent to traffic them, and possessing and carrying unlicensed firearms and ammunition”. The verdict came after the court consulted the Grand Muft
author: AFP in Cairo

title: Farage brushes aside Reform controversies in closing conference speech – UK politics as it happened
text: 11.43 EDT 'Sometimes we will get things wrong,' says Farage in conference closing speech Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has downplayed the controversies that overshadowed his party’s conference yesterday. “Much of mainstream media today says the Reform UK conference was subdued,” he told audience members in his closing remarks. “Are you subdued?” He continued: I tell you what we learned yesterday and today. There will be times in this journey when there are good days, and times when there are difficult days. More often than not, things will be put upon us that are unfair. But sometimes we will make mistakes, sometimes we will get things wrong and get a bit of a kicking for it. But what this conference has shown is whatever you throw at the leadership, whatever you throw at the people’s army, we immediately pick ourselves up, dust ourselves down and start all over again.” Nigel Farage delivering his closing speech at the Reform UK conference in Birmingham. Photograph: Stefan Rousseau/PA

title: Black-clad protesters in balaclavas block road at port of Dover in Kent
text: Balaclava-wearing protesters blocking a road in Dover on Saturday. Photograph: /SWNS View image in fullscreen Balaclava-wearing protesters blocking a road in Dover on Saturday. Photograph: /SWNS Kent Black-clad protesters in balaclavas block road at port of Dover in Kent Port authorities say access roads ‘free flowing’ again after large group forces road closures in both directions Donna Ferguson , Priya Bharadia and agencies Sat 5 Sep 2026 12.23 EDT First published on Sat 5 Sep 2026 04.57 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Dozens of people dressed in black and wearing balaclavas blocked the road at the port of Dover in Kent , forcing closures in both directions on Saturday morning. Kent police said they were were in attendance and engaging with the protest, which the Port of Dover described as a “public order incident”. No arrests were made during the incident. Responsibility for the demonstration appears to have been claimed by an anti-immigration group with links to the far right. The behaviour of the participants and the travel disruption they have caused has been condemned by the government. Traffic in and out of the port on the A20 was stopped, causing delays of up to 30
author: Donna Ferguson, Priya Bharadia and agencies

text: Переговоры Владимира Путина с Уиткоффом и Кушнером проходят в Кремле. Главное из заявлений президента РФ: - Просьба о прекращении ударов по Киеву пришла по официальным каналам; - Путин заявил, что удары по Киеву не наносились с нуля часов сегодняшних суток; - Россия не договаривалась с Украиной о более широком перемирии на три дня, о котором заявляли в Киеве, сообщил Владимир Путин; - Путин заявил, что украинская сторона значительно снизила количество атак; - Трамп не останавливается в своих попытках внести вклад в урегулирование российско-украинского конфликта; - Путин заявил на встрече с Уиткоффом и Кушнером, что контакты подобного рода всегда идут на пользу; - Путин подчеркнул, что Уиткофф и Кушнер после Москвы отправятся в Киев; - Российский лидер заявил, что Москве комфортно работать с Уиткоффом и Кушнером. - РФ сделает все от нее зависящее для обеспечения безопасности переговоров и посредников в лице Уиткоффа и Кушнера, заявил Путин. Главное из заявлений Уиткоффа: - Уиткофф назвал общение с Путиным одной из самых лучших и памятных историй для него; - Он поблагодарил Путина за встречу; - Уиткофф передал Путину благодарность семьи Гилмана за его освобождение, президент ответил,
